# Axe da Ilha — Capoeira Malta

> Capoeira classes for adults and kids of all levels in Mellieha and Pembroke, Malta.
> Afro-Brazilian martial art combining music, acrobatics, dance and community.
> Founded by Monitor Tartaruga Ninja (Manuel Perrone) and Instrutora Portugesa (Dangeory Amaral), in association with Capoeira Oxossi (Mestre Índio, Bahia).

## Classes
- Adults and kids, all levels, free first class
- Locations: Mellieha Judo Club, 228 Triq il-Kbira, Mellieha; Malta Judo Federation, Triq Alamein, Pembroke
- Contact: WhatsApp +356 9991 0088

## Events
- Annual international Capoeira event: next edition 2–4 October 2026
